w:r.w:t: The Project Charter officially authorizes the project and allocates resources. The chartering process forms the project core team and officially kicks off the project.

The Charter is where you will define a project scope, create an estimated timeline, and establish a project budget. Once this document has been completed and approved, the Initiation Phase closes and the project moves into the Planning Phase.
Project Charters should be developed cooperatively with the project core team and approved by the Project Sponsor, Business Owner, and resource owners.

Note: The PM Lite Project Charter Template is customizable as you see fit, on a per project basis, meeting specific needs of the project and/or your organization’s policies. The below sections are suggestions but can be tailored as applicable.

w:tblDescription.w:val: The table is where the project roles will be listed with their assignees name, their responsibility, and assigned a RACI role. A RACI chart is a useful tool to use in order to ensure clear divisions of roles and expectations. It is meant to specify how each person relates to that role by marking them with R, A, C, or I. R = Responsible for completing A = Accountable for ensuring the completion C = Consulted prior to completion I = Informed of the results post completion
